entities.summary: Philippe Lafontaine (b. 1955-05-24, Gosselies) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Gosselies and Belgium. Known in the fields of belgium, composers & musicians, europe.
